title: Circle
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Circle
learningObjectives: Explain why circle() takes a diameter, so the slider's radius value must be doubled to draw a circle of that radius
Identify how createSlider(0, 200, 100) sets the minimum, maximum, and starting radius of the circle
Trace the flow of a value from radiusSlider.value() in draw() to the size of the rendered circle on each frame
Explain how width/2 and height/2 center the circle regardless of the canvas dimensions
Describe how text() displays the live radius label and value inside the draw() loop
